articles.title: Quote of the day by Irvin D. Yalom: ‘People who feel empty never heal by merging with another incomplete person’ - Existential psychiatrist on why emotional healing starts from within
articles.description: Quote of the day by Irvin D. Yalom: Irvin D. Yalom’s quote emphasizes that attempting to heal our internal void by connecting with someone equally flawed leads to codependency instead of a true bond. Relying on another to remedy our insecurities results in superficial relationships. True personal development necessitates addressing our psychological scars solo. In today's dating culture, the misconception that someone can finalize our identity prevails. Fostering self-healing paves the way for deeper, more satisfying relationships.
